data.name: Ibadah
data.gender_notes: Ibadah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: To serve and obey Allah (God) in all aspects of life. The name Ibadah carries the meaning “Worship, devotion, obedience” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ibadah usually hope their child will grow to embody worship, devotion, obedience and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A commitment to living a righteous and pious life
data.etymology: Ibadah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Worship, devotion, obedience.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibadah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Ibadah
in_english.long_meaning: Ibadah refers to the worship and devotion to God, which is one of the fundamental principles of Islam, and encompasses the worship of God, and the attainment of nearness to Him, through obedience and submission to His will

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, "Ibadah" refers to acts of worship and obedience towards Allah. These acts include rituals such as prayer (Salah), fasting during Ramadan, giving Zakat (charity), and performing Hajj (pilgrimage to Mecca). Ibadah is an integral part of Muslim daily life, shaping their identity, community bonding, and societal norms. It is a continuous endeavor, producing a collective consciousness and sense of purpose towards Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Ibadah is about building a profound relationship with Allah. Through Ibadah, Muslims express their devotion, seek forgiveness for their sins, and purify their souls with the intention of drawing closer to Allah. The concept of Ibadah is a reminder of the Primary Essence of Allah as the ultimate Reality, and the secondary essence of human beings as the servants of Allah. It instills humility, gratitude, and godliness, encouraging Muslims to prioritize their spiritual connection above worldly desires.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Worship, devotion, obedience" symbolizes To serve and obey Allah (God) in all aspects of life. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ibadah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of worship, devotion, obedience.
